messages:
Maya (CS): Quick capture from a Solara Health onboarding call just now. A few product asks + an onboarding blocker around KMS. Dropping notes so we can triage.
Jon (PM): great — paste the asks and any urgency flags.
Maya (CS): raw asks from customer: 
  - per-route billing breakdown (export & UI)
  - ability to disable embeddings per route (prefer a toggle)
  - console-only onboarding checklist for Dedicated (networking, KMS policies)
  - alert if a model rollout increases tail latency for their routes
Lina (CSE): they hit the KMS key policy step in the console. docs show example IAM and TF, they need step-by-step console guidance and screenshots.
Ravi (SRE): for Dedicated customers we can document the KMS key grant pattern. Ops-side it's a 1-hour runbook build.
Eli (Eng): per-route billing UI: we have raw telemetry but no per-route aggregate table exposed. Implementation: aggregator job + UI surface. Ballpark: 2 devs x 6 wks.
Jon (PM): which of these is blocking their go-live/renewal?
Maya (CS): onboarding checklist (KMS) is blocking cutover to prod. Others are important but not immediate. They mentioned finance wants the per-route forecast ahead of their budget meeting next month.
Jon (PM): priority: onboarding checklist = P0, per-route forecast = P1, latency alert = P2, embeddings toggle = P3.
Maya (CS): they suggested a compact "monthly estimate" on the route detail page. Said finance people only want a quick forecast, not perfect accuracy.
Eli (Eng): we can prototype a simple projection: monthly_tokens = avg_daily_calls * avg_tokens * 30. Add a variance badge if historical stddev > 2x mean. Fast UI spike doable in ~3 days.
Maya (CS): they shared a sanitized sample CSV (pasted):
```
route_id,avg_daily_calls,avg_tokens
cart/price,800,60
search/suggest,2700,15
chat/notify,150,420
```

Lina (CSE): can you ask them to include a flagged example of a promo-day spike? That will help the variance UX.
Maya (CS): asked. They agreed to provide a promo spike example and to run a staging pilot for the metric next week.
Jon (PM): action items: 
  1) Lina: author console-only KMS onboarding checklist + screenshots, add to onboarding-docs (due Thu EOD).
  2) Eli: build a quick metrics prototype for route monthly estimate (3d spike).
  3) PM: file product ticket for per-route billing aggregates and include infra estimate (blocker for scale).
  4) CS: coordinate pilot window and get sanitized traffic CSV (Maya).
Lina (CSE): taking item 1. I'll include a trimmed IAM policy snippet and a pure-console instruction path.
Eli (Eng): taking item 2. I'll push a staging branch and drop a mock screenshot in the ticket.
Ravi (SRE): I'll review checklist for any Dedicated-specific caveats and add a note about key rotation.
feedback-bot: Ticket created: CS-4991 "Solara: console-only onboarding checklist" (assigned Lina).
Maya (CS): scheduling a short sync Tue 10am PT with Solara and team to validate the pilot. Invite sent.
Jon (PM): I'll add a short spec for embeddings toggle vs model-routing. Need complexity estimate from Eng before committing.
Maya (CS): Solara is comfortable delaying per-route billing until after pilot, but wants the monthly estimate on route page by pilot time.
Eli (Eng): I'll aim for a prototype Monday AM. If data variance is high we can show a warning + a link to raw export.
Maya (CS): thanks all. I'll update the customer tracker and mark this as onboarding-risk until checklist is merged.
Lina (CSE): PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/onboard-checklists/pull/427 (WIP).
Maya (CS): noted. Closing thread for now — will reopen if Solara adds more. :white_check_mark:
